Specify an allocation model without data

Source: R/08-spax_spec.R
spec_clm.Rd

Experimental. spec_clm() and spec_huff() declare an allocation model with its decay kernel and its parameters, each either estimated ("fit") or held at a number. A specification holds no data: it is checked as far as that is possible without data, and it is bound to prepared inputs when it is used with spax().

Usage

spec_clm(
  decay = decay_gaussian(),
  outside = "fit",
  beta = 1,
  kappa = 1,
  by_group = character()
)

spec_huff(
  decay = decay_power(),
  beta = "fit",
  kappa = 1,
  by_group = character()
)

# S3 method for class 'spax_allocation_spec'
format(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'spax_spec'
format(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'spax_spec'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

decay

A decay: decay_gaussian(), decay_exponential(), decay_power(), decay_custom(), a decay_kernel() or one of "gaussian", "exponential" and "power" (the last two forms mean sigma = "fit"). Or a named list of these with one element per demand group.

outside

The outside weight v0: "fit" (the default), 0 (no outside option), a single positive number (held), a named numeric vector by group (held), or a named list by group whose elements are "fit" or a number.

beta

The attractiveness exponent: "fit", or a single finite number greater than 0 that holds it.

kappa

A single finite number greater than 0, the scale of the attractiveness (kappa * supply)^beta. It is held.

by_group

For data with demand groups, the parameters that differ by group: "sigma" and, for spec_clm(), "v0". A single decay or outside weight listed here must be fitted ("fit"), because a held value is one number; hold values by group through a list or vector instead.

x

A model specification.

...

Unused.

Value

A spax_allocation_spec (also a spax_spec): a list with kind ("clm" or "huff"), decay, outside (0 for spec_huff()), beta, kappa and by_group.

Details

Conditional logit (spec_clm()). Demand at an origin goes to each facility in proportion to its attractiveness times the decay weight of the travel time, and to an outside option with weight v0. The attractiveness of a facility is (kappa * supply)^beta. outside = 0 removes the outside option, which is the Huff model.

Huff (spec_huff()). The same model without an outside option. Its default decay is a power kernel and its default beta is fitted.

Parameters. A parameter is a number (held) or "fit" (estimated), in its own slot:

  • the decay's sigma, in the decay object (decay_gaussian() and its relatives);

  • the outside weight v0, in outside (conditional logit only);

  • the attractiveness exponent beta.

kappa is a scale that is always held.

Demand groups. For data with demand groups, a named list of decays gives each group its own kernel; a number in an element holds that group's sigma. outside can be a named numeric vector (held by group) or a named list whose elements are "fit" or a number. by_group lets one fitted decay ("sigma") or one fitted outside weight ("v0") differ by group. Group-specific parameters can be fitted only to counts recorded by group; a held sigma cannot differ by group unless the decay is given by group.

FCA decays. An allocation model refuses decay_step(), decay_inverse() and a raster sigma, which are for the FCA specifications (spec_e2sfca()).

See also

Other allocation interface: decay_gaussian(), obs_flows(), prep_data(), spax(), spax_access_values-methods, spax_allocation-methods, spax_huff()

Examples

# Huff: power decay and fitted exponent, no outside option
spec_huff()
#> <spax spec> Huff model (no outside option)
#>   decay       power (sigma = exponent): fit
#>   attraction  (kappa * supply)^beta: kappa = 1, beta = fit
#>   outside     none

# Conditional logit with a fitted outside weight, and with one held at 0.05
spec_clm(decay = decay_gaussian(), outside = "fit")
#> <spax spec> conditional logit with an outside option
#>   decay       gaussian (sigma = travel scale): fit
#>   attraction  (kappa * supply)^beta: kappa = 1, beta = 1
#>   outside     v0: fit
spec_clm(decay = decay_exponential(), outside = 0.05)
#> <spax spec> conditional logit with an outside option
#>   decay       exponential (sigma = rate): fit
#>   attraction  (kappa * supply)^beta: kappa = 1, beta = 1
#>   outside     v0: 0.05

# Evaluate at given values: everything is a number
spec_huff(decay = decay_power(sigma = 1.5), beta = 1)
#> <spax spec> Huff model (no outside option)
#>   decay       power (sigma = exponent): 1.5
#>   attraction  (kappa * supply)^beta: kappa = 1, beta = 1
#>   outside     none

# Demand groups: a kernel for each group and outside weights by group
spec_clm(
  decay = list(young = decay_gaussian(5), old = decay_power(2)),
  outside = list(young = "fit", old = 0)
)
#> <spax spec> conditional logit with an outside option
#>   decay       by group: young gaussian (5), old power (2)
#>   attraction  (kappa * supply)^beta: kappa = 1, beta = 1
#>   outside     v0 by group: young fit, old 0
